title: "Curriculum Vitae"

```{r}
#| label: cv-setup
#| include: false
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

db_path <- here("cv-app-test", "cv.db")
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), db_path)

lt_work       <- dbReadTable(con, "lt_work")
education     <- dbReadTable(con, "education")
publications  <- dbReadTable(con, "publications")
admin         <- dbReadTable(con, "admin")
certifications <- dbReadTable(con, "certifications")
papers        <- dbReadTable(con, "papers_in_progress")
references    <- dbReadTable(con, "references")

dbDisconnect(con)

# Current academic positions: endMonth == "Present"
# lt_work columns: institution | startMonth | startYear | endMonth | endYear | where | detail
# Multiple detail rows per position (title, courses, etc.) — keep only the first per institution+year
current_positions <- lt_work |>
  dplyr::filter(endMonth == "Present") |>
  dplyr::group_by(institution, startYear) |>
  dplyr::slice(1) |>   # first row = the title row (not "COURSES TAUGHT ---")
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(startYear))

# Recent publications (10 most recent)
recent_pubs <- publications |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(year)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(year)) |>
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 10)
```

---

## Current Positions

```{r}
#| label: cv-current
#| output: asis

if (nrow(current_positions) == 0) {
  cat("*See PDF for full employment history.*\n")
} else {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(current_positions))) {
    pos <- current_positions[i, ]
    
    loc   <- if (!is.na(pos$where)      && pos$where != "")      pos$where      else ""
    start <- if (!is.na(pos$startYear)  && pos$startYear != "")  as.character(pos$startYear) else ""
    title <- if (!is.na(pos$detail)     && pos$detail != "")     pos$detail     else ""

    cat(sprintf('**%s**  \n', pos$institution))
    if (title != "") cat(sprintf('%s  \n', title))
    if (loc   != "") cat(sprintf('%s', loc))
    if (start != "") cat(sprintf(' · %s–Present', start))
    cat('\n\n')
  }
}
```

---

## Education

```{r}
#| label: cv-education
#| output: asis

for (i in seq_len(nrow(education))) {
  ed <- education[i, ]
  
  start <- if (!is.na(ed$startYear)) as.character(ed$startYear) else ""
  end   <- if (!is.na(ed$endYear))   as.character(ed$endYear)   else ""
  years <- if (start != "" || end != "") paste0(start, "–", end) else ""
  
  cat(sprintf('**%s**  \n', ed$degree))
  cat(sprintf('%s', ed$inst))
  if (years != "") cat(sprintf(' · %s', years))
  if (!is.na(ed$where) && ed$where != "") cat(sprintf(' · %s', ed$where))
  cat('\n\n')
}
```

## Selected Publications

Showing 10 most recent of `r nrow(publications)` total peer-reviewed publications.
[Download full CV (PDF)](jpbDataDrivenCV.pdf) for the complete list.

```{r}
#| label: cv-pubs
#| output: asis

for (i in seq_len(nrow(recent_pubs))) {
  pub <- recent_pubs[i, ]
  
  cat('<div class="publication-item">\n')
  cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-year">%s</div>\n',
              ifelse(!is.na(pub$year), pub$year, "")))
  cat('<div class="pub-content">\n')
  cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-title">%s</div>\n', pub$articleTitle))
  
  if (!is.na(pub$authors) && pub$authors != "") {
    cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-authors">%s</div>\n', pub$authors))
  }
  if (!is.na(pub$journal) && pub$journal != "") {
    cat(sprintf('<div class="pub-venue"><em>%s</em></div>\n', pub$journal))
  }
  
  cat('</div>\n</div>\n\n')
}
```

## Administrative Experience

```{r}
#| label: cv-admin
#| output: asis

for (i in seq_len(nrow(admin))) {
  a <- admin[i, ]
  cat(sprintf('**%s**  \n', a$title))
  cat(sprintf('*%s*\n\n', a$institution))
  
  if (!is.na(a$detail) && nchar(trimws(a$detail)) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf(
      '<div style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#555;margin:-0.5rem 0 1rem 0;">%s</div>\n\n',
      a$detail
    ))
  }
}
```

## References

Available upon request. [Contact me](mailto:john.broussard@rutgers.edu) directly.

```{r}
#| label: cv-refs
#| output: asis

for (i in seq_len(nrow(references))) {
  ref <- references[i, ]
  cat(sprintf('**%s**  \n', ref$name))
  if (!is.na(ref$title))   cat(sprintf('%s  \n', ref$title))
  if (!is.na(ref$details)) cat(sprintf('*%s*\n\n', ref$details))
}
```
